seo.title: Active Navigation in Digital Channels — campaigns inside the decision journey | Advia
seo.description: Campaigns on the web, YouTube and social media placed on the sources your consumer consults while comparing and deciding.

hero.eyebrow: We turn your brand into the answer
hero.titular: Vera identifies where you will be relevant to your consumers and turns your ad into the <key>answer</key> they need
hero.lede: Campaigns in digital media where your consumers are looking for you without knowing it.

donde.lede: Vera simulates your consumer's decision journey, letting us understand where you will be relevant: web articles, YouTube videos, social media posts. That is where we position you, where the consumer arrives looking for answers.

puntos.titulo: The most frequent stop in the journey
puntos.texto: There are thousands of articles answering every question in a decision. It is the channel that brings the volume.

puntos.titulo: The media AI gets its information from
puntos.texto: When ChatGPT or Gemini answer, they consult media outlets. We position you during the research in these new channels.

puntos.titulo: Video, display and native, depending on the goal
puntos.texto: Video for awareness, rich media for attention, native for qualified traffic. From the lower end of awareness to the upper end of performance.

puntos.titulo: The stop where the doubt lasts longest
puntos.texto: Reviews, comparisons and demos: the consumer watches them through because they haven't decided yet.

puntos.titulo: In the video they are watching, not by affinity
puntos.texto: We enter the specific videos flagged by the simulation, without relying on interest-based targeting.

puntos.titulo: The format that conveys the most value
puntos.texto: If you don't have your own videos, you are present all the same in relevant third-party videos.

cierre.titular: We <key>halved</key> the cost per qualified visit for an automotive advertiser
cierre.lede: Find out what we can do for you.
